_note: months is null where the state imposes no statutory cap statewide.
_notice: General reference, not legal advice. Statutes change and vary by jurisdiction; verify every figure against the current official state code before relying on it. Last reviewed 2026-05.

CA.citation: Cal. Civ. Code § 1950.5 (AB 12, eff. 2024-07-01: 1 month for most landlords; 2 months for the small-landlord exception under § 1950.5(c)(4)(B), i.e. a natural person (or LLC of natural persons) owning at most 2 residential rental properties with at most 4 dwelling units total; active-duty servicemember tenants stay at 1 month even when leasing from a small landlord)

CO.citation: Colo. Rev. Stat. § 38-12-102.5 (2 months' rent; eff. 2023-08-07 per HB23-1099)

CT.citation: Conn. Gen. Stat. § 47a-21 (1 month if tenant is 62+)

DE.citation: Del. Code tit. 25 § 5514 (1 month for lease >= 1 year; cap varies for shorter terms)

GA.citation: O.C.G.A. § 44-7-30.1 (2 months' rent; HB 404 Safe at Home Act, eff. 2024-07-01)

IL.citation: 765 ILCS 710 (no statewide cap; Chicago RLTO caps at 1.5x first month's rent)

KS.citation: Kan. Stat. § 58-2550 (1.5 months furnished; pet deposit additional)

LA.citation: La. Rev. Stat. § 9:3251 et seq. (no statutory cap)

MA.citation: M.G.L. ch. 186 § 15B (1 month + last month's rent + key deposit; interest required)

MD.citation: Md. Code, Real Prop. § 8-203(b) (1 month; HB 693 Renters' Rights and Stabilization Act, eff. 2024-10-01)

MN.citation: Minn. Stat. § 504B.178 (no cap; interest required at 1% per year)

MT.citation: Mont. Code § 70-25-101 et seq. (no statutory cap)

NC.citation: N.C.G.S. § 42-51 (1.5 months month-to-month; 2 months for terms >= 6 months)

NE.citation: Neb. Rev. Stat. § 76-1416 (1.25 months if pet)

NH.citation: N.H. Rev. Stat. § 540-A:6 (1 month or $100, whichever greater)

OH.citation: Ohio Rev. Code § 5321.16 (no cap; interest required on amounts > $50 held > 6 months)

OR.citation: ORS 90.300 (no statewide cap; some local ordinances apply)

PA.citation: 68 P.S. § 250.511a (2 months first year; 1 month thereafter)

TN.citation: Tenn. Code § 66-28-301 (no cap; must be held in separate account)

WV.citation: W. Va. Code § 37-6A-1 et seq. (no statutory cap)
